He is a 6 ft 6 in tall (1.98 m)[http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=SHD ACB.com Álex Abrines | altura | 1.98 m {{es icon}}.] [[shooting guard]]-[[small forward]]. He is right handed. ==Professional career== Abrines joined the [[Spanish ACB League]] club [[FC Barcelona Basquet|FC Barcelona]] in July 2012, in exchange for [[Fran Vázquez]].[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=86205 Barça Regal y Unicaja acuerdan el intercambio entre Fran Vázquez y Abrines {{es icon}}.] Abrines has officially declared for the [[2013 NBA Draft]] and is projected to be a late first round pick.http://www.sportando.net/eng/usa/nba/54634/alex-abrines-declared-the-2013-nba-draft.html Alex Abrines declared the 2013 NBA Draft ==Spanish national team== Abrines has played with the junior national teams of Spain.
